run_motion_graph_cli: run the motion graph CLI to construct a graph from BVH motion files and generate new motions
load_parallel_bvh_motions: load BVH motion capture files in parallel with configurable skeleton orientation and scale
construct_motion_graph: construct a motion graph from resampled motions using weighted joint position and velocity similarity
reduce_graph_scc: reduce the motion graph by collapsing strongly connected components into single nodes
create_random_motion: create a random motion by traversing the motion graph with configurable length and blend parameters
